glosses: ambush, ambuscade (a disposition or arrangement of troops for attacking an enemy unexpectedly from a concealed station)

examples.en: He was caught in an ambush.

examples.text: Tom foi morto em uma emboscada.
examples.en: Tom was killed in an ambush.

examples.text: Tom explicou como seria a emboscada.
examples.en: Tom explained how the ambush would work.
